changes.name: scheduled_source_word_low64
changes.proof: ADDRESS_LIST prefix length is node_bytes+32: 48/56/64 bytes. The 128-bit producer only crosses a prefix at position48 for n24; live source7 word is slot1 selected_index0. Aligned n16/n32 prefixes use list_window for subsequent list bytes. PREFIX_MESSAGE never decodes source7; PREFIX_LIST literals already access only firstnode[79:0]. Scalar path unchanged.

changes.name: response_pending_ownership
changes.proof: Invariant awaiting_response[j] == complete[j] && !(response_held && held_tag==j). Reset both zero. Complete events (zero_request accept, final permutation return) set both complete and pending. Publishing removes only pending and establishes held ownership on the same edge. Retirement removes complete/busy and old held ownership; if another response is published, its pending bit is removed. Busy/pending reservation prevents same slot from completing or accepting while held. Tag priority, payload publish edge and retirement semantics remain unchanged.
